lastResponse.text: Yes. Use this message: “Hi, this is [your name]. I am very sick. I need electricity for my medical equipment. I am very sick, and I need power kept on for my medical equipment. Please call me back as soon as possible.” If speaking gets hard, just read those lines slowly. If you feel in immediate danger, call nine one one.
